verdict.rationale: Statsig documents its own user-configured behaviors that run unattended after setup. Feature Gates can be set up as Scheduled Rollouts that deploy gradually over time, and Autotune automatically shifts traffic toward the winning variant. These are narrow, feature-specific automations rather than a general background automation capability; CLI/CI/CD scripting is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder, user-defined recurring schedules or triggers beyond rollouts and bandits, agent-driven autonomous background tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Gradually deploy a feature over time by setting up a Feature Gate as a Scheduled Rollout.
They automatically find the best variant among a group of candidates while dynamically allocating traffic to optimize for a single target metric.
